name: @octocodeai/octocode-native
description: Native Octocode CLI, tool runtime, and engine primitives
author: Guy Bary <bgauryy@octocodeai.com>

scripts.build:addon: cargo build -p octocode-native --release --lib --features napi-addon && node scripts/copy-local-runtime-addon.cjs release
scripts.build:addon:dev: cargo build -p octocode-native --lib --features napi-addon && node scripts/copy-local-runtime-addon.cjs debug
scripts.build:engine: napi build --manifest-path crates/engine/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --release --no-default-features --features portable-default,napi-addon --js .engine-generated.cjs --dts .engine-generated.d.ts && node scripts/postbuild-engine.cjs
scripts.build:engine:dev: napi build --manifest-path crates/engine/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --no-default-features --features portable-default,napi-addon --js .engine-generated.cjs --dts .engine-generated.d.ts && node scripts/postbuild-engine.cjs
scripts.build:all: yarn clean:binaries && yarn build:darwin-arm64 && yarn build:darwin-x64 && yarn build:linux-x64-gnu && yarn build:linux-x64-musl && yarn build:linux-arm64-gnu && yarn build:windows-x64
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: cargo build -p octocode-native --release --bins --no-default-features --target aarch64-apple-darwin && cargo build -p octocode-native --release --lib --features napi-addon --target aarch64-apple-darwin && napi build --manifest-path crates/engine/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin --no-default-features --features portable-default,napi-addon --js .engine-generated.cjs --dts .engine-generated.d.ts && node scripts/postbuild-engine.cjs darwin-arm64 && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs darwin-arm64
scripts.build:darwin-x64: cargo build -p octocode-native --release --bins --no-default-features --target x86_64-apple-darwin && cargo build -p octocode-native --release --lib --features napi-addon --target x86_64-apple-darwin && napi build --manifest-path crates/engine/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin --no-default-features --features portable-default,napi-addon --js .engine-generated.cjs --dts .engine-generated.d.ts && node scripts/postbuild-engine.cjs darwin-x64 && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs darwin-x64
scripts.build:linux-arm64-gnu: cargo build -p octocode-native --release --bins --no-default-features --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && cargo build -p octocode-native --release --lib --features napi-addon --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && napi build --manifest-path crates/engine/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --release --cross-compile --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --no-default-features --features portable-default,napi-addon --js .engine-generated.cjs --dts .engine-generated.d.ts && node scripts/postbuild-engine.cjs linux-arm64-gnu && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs linux-arm64-gnu
scripts.build:linux-x64-gnu: cargo build -p octocode-native --release --bins --no-default-features --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && cargo build -p octocode-native --release --lib --features napi-addon --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && napi build --manifest-path crates/engine/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --release --cross-compile --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --no-default-features --features portable-default,napi-addon --js .engine-generated.cjs --dts .engine-generated.d.ts && node scripts/postbuild-engine.cjs linux-x64-gnu && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs linux-x64-gnu
scripts.build:linux-x64-musl: cargo build -p octocode-native --release --bins --no-default-features --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && cargo build -p octocode-native --release --lib --features napi-addon --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && napi build --manifest-path crates/engine/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --release --cross-compile --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl --no-default-features --features portable-default,napi-addon --js .engine-generated.cjs --dts .engine-generated.d.ts && node scripts/postbuild-engine.cjs linux-x64-musl && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs linux-x64-musl
scripts.build:windows-x64: cargo build -p octocode-native --release --bins --no-default-features --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && cargo build -p octocode-native --release --lib --features napi-addon --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && napi build --manifest-path crates/engine/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --release --cross-compile --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --no-default-features --features portable-default,napi-addon --js .engine-generated.cjs --dts .engine-generated.d.ts && node scripts/postbuild-engine.cjs win32-x64-msvc && node scripts/copy-binaries.cjs win32-x64-msvc
scripts.clean:binaries: find npm -type f \( -name 'octocode' -o -name 'octocode.exe' -o -name 'octocode-regex-worker' -o -name 'octocode-regex-worker.exe' -o -name '*.node' \) -delete && rm -f octocode-native.*.node octocode-engine.*.node
scripts.test: node bin/platform.test.cjs && vitest run && cargo test -p octocode-native --no-default-features && cargo test -p octocode-engine --all-features
scripts.test:rust: cargo test -p octocode-native --no-default-features && cargo test -p octocode-engine --all-features
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy -p octocode-native --no-default-features --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p octocode-engine --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.check:rust: cargo check -p octocode-native --no-default-features --all-targets && cargo check -p octocode-engine --all-targets --all-features
scripts.verify: yarn fmt:rust:check && yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn deps:rust && yarn loader:check && yarn verify:napi-abi && yarn version:check
